bifrost: none for USB accessory management; related: springboard/src/bare/input.rs (evdev device discovery), springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (file grants), springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (permission manifest)
summary: Accessory Access is a USB-only framework: an app registers listeners that match connected USB accessories through IOUSBHost and receives attach and detach events. BifrOSt has no SDK API for USB accessories, no matching criteria, no listener events and no USB permission grant. Input devices are handled inside the shell, not exposed to apps as accessories.

features.note: No SDK type manages USB accessories or the listeners attached to them. The SDK has no USB module under springboard/sdk/src/.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/input.rs (Device, device discovery by name hint)
features.note: input.rs finds evdev input devices for the shell only. Apps get no accessory object for any USB device.

No matching criteria (vendor, product or class) for selecting accessories.
